algorithm.loop: attempt -> diagnose failure -> choose improvement strategy -> build candidate solver -> counterfactual test (screen on 6 probes, confirm on 6 fresh probes, paired streams) -> adopt/rollback -> learn from outcome (strategy values + intensities + delayed credit from next round's solves)
algorithm.package: src/rsi_v2 (every file hashed at freeze; code_hash in the PREREG_FREEZE ledger record)

compute.SINGLE_5X: 1 round: 5 x attempt (each task gets the same 5 attempt streams as the 5 recursive rounds) + 5 x gate budget
compute.evaluation: identical for all arms: 3000 executions per holdout task, stream keyed by (seed, split, task index) only
compute.recursive_arms: 5 rounds x (40 tasks x attempt_budget + gate_round_budget)
compute.unit: one program execution on one input (every execution is metered; global-counter cross-check)

dev_history: ledger records dev-00 .. dev-07 (including the failed designs dev-00..dev-05). The frozen design is dev-07.
power: dev-07 (n=12): H1 mean +1.08 (sd 2.11), H2 mean +0.42 (sd 1.38); dev estimates are optimistic because they survived design iteration. With n=300, one-sided alpha 0.025 (Holm worst case) and power 0.8, the minimum detectable mean differences are about +0.34 tasks for H1 (~1/3 of the dev estimate) and +0.22 tasks for H2 (~1/2 of the dev estimate).

primary_metric.definition: number of the 24 external-family holdout tasks per seed whose train examples AND hidden longer test examples are all reproduced exactly by the program the arm's final solver finds within the evaluation budget

statistics.also_reported: mean, SD, 95% percentile bootstrap CI, wins/ties/losses, dz
statistics.decision_rule: a hypothesis is supported iff mean(a - b) > 0 and its Holm-adjusted p < alpha; otherwise it is reported as a null result
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down over H1 and H2
statistics.test: paired (by seed) sign-flip permutation test, one-sided H_a: mean(a - b) > 0, 20000 permutations from a fixed deterministic stream

stopping_and_integrity: Every (arm, seed) in 1001-1300 runs exactly once after the PREREG_FREEZE ledger record; no interim looks; no parameter, code, task or analysis change after freeze (enforced by hashes); a crashed unit may only be re-run deterministically (UNIT_RESTART record); the report is produced by the frozen runner and states the result whatever it is.

tasks.note: external holdout families are never seen in train/probe; all tasks behaviour-distinct across splits

title: rsi_v2 confirmatory battery: does adapting the improvement process compound beyond equal-compute one-shot improvement?
